learning_outcomes.text: Map the fundamental activities carried out in the company in the different functional areas as well as in the various company processes.
Calculate production costs and use them in current management decisions.

syllabus_topics: Company functions. Operational functions and production and logistics processes; the R&D function and the new product development process; the marketing and sales function; support and company management functions, including administrative, finance and control, quality and information systems functions.

Costs. Cost classification. Cost measurement. Full cost calculation. Contribution margin. Analysis of relationships between costs, volumes and profits. Cost analysis for current business management decisions.
assessment_rules: The evaluation of the student's preparation will be based on the acquisition of the concepts, models and methods proposed, as well as the ability to apply them autonomously and consciously.
